blog.title: Blog — Iwan Kulik
blog.description: The journal of Iwan Kulik's studio: thematic cycles of canvases, the craft of oil painting, buying originals direct from the artist and caring for them.

categories.cycles: On Iwan Kulik's thematic series: how a cycle begins, why the same figures return from canvas to canvas, and what holds hundreds of works together.
categories.technique: How an oil painting is built: ground, underpainting, layers of paint, varnish. Studio materials and the reasons this craft has lasted for centuries.
categories.collecting: Buying an original direct from the artist: certificate of authenticity, price, delivery. And care at home — light, humidity, the mistakes to avoid.
categories.artist: Life beyond the studio: a village near Cherkasy, Kharkiv, the 1990 move to Warsaw, a first show at the Sejm, an Italian wine label and The Lancet.
